body:

author: Knightsnigh
body:
Long time Orna player here (at least 2 years)

I started orna after growing fed up with Pokémon Go (day one player, still active but way less than before)...

I'd say Orna is certainly got an active player base but almost all of the players and conversations are on discord.

Orna is a lot of fun but it gets grindy - don't expect to get to end game fast. It takes a lot of time and effort to fully gear out your final setups....

Saying that it's one of the most flexible mobile games I've ever played. You can't make "mistakes" as everything is interchangable and you can swap classes/play styles on the fly which is a huge part of the appeal to me.

Also you can do it as a totally f2p approach. There isn't really a "pay 2 win" model - sure you can speed up some bits but it doesn't actually help you much.

I see quite a few active players locally.
